Construction mode has many of the same controls available in the editor.  A kerbal can only work on one part at a time, so placing parts in symmetry, and removing multiple parts at once is not possible.
Only parts below a certain weight and size can be constructed with. Constructing in low gravity allows more parts to be changed out.
Engineers on EVA can attach and remove parts from a vessel with their welding laser.
Access Construction mode by pressing I or clicking the Construction Mode App.
